title: Catering Keywords that Will Get You Clients

facts.fact: The page recommends targeting catering keywords with a keyword difficulty below 10 and a traffic potential above 300 as a rule of thumb.
facts.quote: Aim for KW difficulty under 10 with traffic potential over 300.

facts.fact: The page describes keyword difficulty as a rating on a scale from 1 to 100, where a higher number means it is harder to rank in the top 10.
facts.quote: This is a rating between 1 and 100. The higher the number, the harder it will be to rank in the top 10 for the given keyword.

facts.fact: The keyword 'catering for 50 people' has an average search volume of 600 searches per month, according to the page's Ahrefs check.
facts.quote: It has an average search volume of 600.

facts.fact: The keyword 'catering for 50 people' has a keyword difficulty of 36 according to the page's Ahrefs check.
facts.quote: There is a KW difficulty of 36 assigned to this phrase.

facts.fact: The page estimates that the keyword 'catering for 50 people' would need more than 47 links, depending on their strength, to rank well on results pages.
facts.quote: this specific phrase would need more than 47 links (depending on their strength) to rank well on results pages.

facts.fact: Google searches for catering show demand for weddings, groups of 30, 40, 50, or 100 people, office lunches, baby showers, and kids' parties.
facts.quote: It turns out that people are searching for catering for weddings, groups of 30, 40, 50, or 100 people, office lunches, baby showers, and kid's parties.

facts.fact: The page was published on 2026-04-05, while its body text refers to optimizing for success in 2024.
The page's keyword metrics come from Ahrefs, which the author describes as a well-known SEO platform.
facts.quote: Using Ahrefs, a well-known SEO platform, I checked some of the keywords we found in our Google Search

facts.fact: Surfer SEO is named as a tool that suggests the number of words, the number of pictures, and how many times catering terms such as 'meal service' or 'main course' should appear in an article.
facts.quote: suggesting the number of words, the number of pictures to use, and how many times certain catering terms like 'meal service' or 'main course' need to appear

facts.fact: Batlinks.io offers catering companies a free video audit of their online visibility, requested by contacting the company.
facts.quote: simply get in touch for a free video audit

facts.fact: The page states that long tail keywords usually have less competition and bring in more qualified potential clients than broad searches.
facts.quote: They usually have less competition and bring in more qualified potential clients

facts.fact: The page advises caterers to check keyword difficulty and search volume before targeting a keyword.
facts.quote: then check keyword difficulty and search volume to make sure you're targeting realistic opportunities
